name: SillyTavern
tagline: Feature-rich local frontend for conversational AI, character cards, and LLM APIs
real_test_summary: Connected to local KoboldCpp on an RTX 3060 12GB with lorebook RAG and Piper TTS active using under 300MB frontend RAM.
pros: Unmatched prompt control, lorebooks, and memory extensions
Zero censorship or cloud message filters
Works with almost every local inference backend
cons: Frontend only — requires a separate backend like Ollama or KoboldCpp
Dense UI settings for first-time users
description: Power-user web interface designed for local LLM backends (KoboldCpp, Ollama, llama.cpp) offering lorebooks, long-term vector memory, TTS voice output, and custom prompt templates.
